title: Allow read access to /sys/devices/system/node for qemu-bridge-helper child process
commit_message:

https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/libvirt/+bug/2079869

 ubuntu-aa/0033-UBUNTU-only-apparmor-for-kvm.powerpc-LP-1680384.patch
 ubuntu-aa/0034-apparmor-virt-aa-helper-access-for-snapped-nova.patch

index 0000000..9ef1c25
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu-aa/lp2079869-allow-access-for-bridge-helper-to-sys-devices-system.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+Description: Allow acess for bridge-helper to sys devices node
+
+qemu-bridge-helper needs to read /sys/devices/system/node
+that is not allowed in the apparmor profile
+it does not make libvirtd fail but add an apparmor
+audit message. This patch allows to remove this apparmor
+warning
+
+Author: Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://launchpad.net/bugs/2079869
+
+---
+ src/security/apparmor/usr.sbin.libvirtd.in | 3 +++
+ 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)
+
+diff --git a/src/security/apparmor/usr.sbin.libvirtd.in b/src/security/apparmor/usr.sbin.libvirtd.in
+index 5fa5c7842..4de4a28bc 100644
+--- a/src/security/apparmor/usr.sbin.libvirtd.in
++++ b/src/security/apparmor/usr.sbin.libvirtd.in
+@@ -137,6 +137,9 @@ profile libvirtd @sbindir@/libvirtd flags=(attach_disconnected) {
+    /etc/qemu/** r,
+    owner @{PROC}/*/status r,
+ 
++   # for gathering information about available host resources
++   /sys/devices/system/node/ r,
++
+    /usr/{lib,lib64,lib/qemu,libexec,libexec/qemu}/qemu-bridge-helper rmix,
+   }
+ 
+-- 
+2.43.0
+
